name: Bellona USA - Turkish Furniture Manufacturing Wholesale

about:
Bellona USA operates from Las Vegas, Nevada, as a distributor and retailer of Turkish-manufactured furniture. The company does not disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founder names on its public-facing materials.

The business curates modern and luxury furniture collections — among them Boheems, Valenty, Picasso, Veronica, Montella, Estella, Plaza, and Mona — spanning living room, dining room, bedroom, and accent categories. It maintains a physical showroom with a virtual tour, runs a dealer portal that provides access to a Basic Line Catalog and an Exclusive 2025 Catalog, and coordinates consumer financing through Synchrony with an 18-month 0% APR offer. Orders over $5,000 qualify for free shipping.

Bellona serves both retail consumers and wholesale buyers. The dealer program indicates B2B relationships with furniture retailers, interior designers, and hospitality specifiers seeking Turkish-made lines. The site supports English, Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese, reflecting a customer base that extends across North and South America.

The company positions itself around Turkish manufacturing heritage, style variety, and educational content — its blog publishes guides on upholstery grades, mattress cooling, wood care, and furniture selection — but does not articulate a founding mission or explicit differentiation statement beyond product assortment and dealer support.
